proposal: Contract pieces SPEC §21 implies (the learner's map, W10; JM-D35 to JM-D39 and JM-D45 approved as working assumptions 2026-10-31). Each entry is a JSON Pointer into a contract under contracts/ (an endpoint for TABLE API-27a) and the value added there. They were adopted in the same change (python -m jana_tools codegen), so the generated Python and TypeScript bindings carry them; this file records what was added and why. No storage change: `map_opened_at:<profile_id>` lives in the device database's existing app_settings table (JM-D45), and the scrubber's snapshots are in-memory replays (JM-D37). The ConceptNode additions are optional properties so a reply from a core before W10 still validates; a W10 core sends every one.

additions.why: The Freshness layer: the newest learning touch of the skill (an attempt, hint or check through kc_mastery.last_seen_at, or a Study activity tagged to it), bucketed against the profile's local day. Optional so a reply from a core before W10 still reads; a W10 core always sends it.

value.description: The newest learning touch of the skill (an attempt, hint or check, or a Study activity tagged to it) against the profile's local day: today, within the last 7 days, within the last 30, longer ago, or not yet. A bucket by code, never a probability (JM-D36).

additions.why: Refresh due is kc_views' needs_review at now, so it always agrees with the node's state.

value.description: The skill's FSRS card is below the review bar (`kc_views` state `needs_review` at now).

additions.why: Since last time: the band rose (`up`) or the skill got its first evidence (`new`) since the map was last opened; null on the first open and on a dated map. 'down' is dropped (review finding 11).

value.description: Since the map was last opened on this device: `up` when the band rose, `new` when the skill had no evidence then and has now; null otherwise, on the first open and on a dated (`as_of`) map.

additions.why: The Study layer's counts on the skill: materials (aids and sources tagged to it), lecture moments (timed transcript chunks tagged at read time) and due cards reviewed at least once (an unreviewed card has no skill tag, review finding 13).

value.description: Study on this skill: tagged materials, tagged lecture moments and due flashcards reviewed at least once.

additions.why: The Notes layer: how many of the tutor's notes cite events on this skill.

value.description: The tutor's notes whose cited events name this skill.

additions.why: Topics your tutor is tracking: the companion summary's topics (at most six), labelled as such (review finding 12).

value.description: One of the companion summary's topics (at most six): a topic your tutor is tracking.

additions.why: The scrubber's date: the map replayed from the event log as it stood at the end of that local day; null for the live map.

value.description: The local date the map stands at (replayed from the event log, read-only), or null for today's live map.

additions.why: Not listed in §21.3: the scrubber offers weekly dates from the profile's first learning event (§21.5), which the client cannot otherwise know. Optional, like the node additions.

value.description: The local date of the profile's first learning event (the scrubber's first week), or null when there is none.

additions.why: Disputed misconceptions return to the map as 'you said this isn't right' (the engine dropped them before W10; review finding 10).
Progress opens on every installed subject as topic tiles (map-first, JM-D35): the subject map's tiles with their UXS-22a rule, bands and the Freshness layer, by code and never a probability.

value.description: Every installed subject as topic tiles (SPEC §21, the learner's map): the subject map's tiles, each with TABLE UXS-22a's first matching rule, its skills by band, its freshest touch, whether one is refresh due, its watched mistakes and its skills changed since last time. Bands, buckets and words by code; never a probability (JM-D36).

kcs.description: How many skills the tile holds.

rule.description: TABLE UXS-22a's first matching row over the tile's skill states: the state whose word, icon, pattern and fill the tile shows.

freshness.description: The freshest of the tile's skills.

refresh_due.description: At least one of the tile's skills is refresh due.

mistakes.description: Watched misconceptions on the tile's skills (any status but resolved).

changed.description: The tile's skills marked up or new since the map was last opened.

additions.why: The skill sheet's Study, notes and tutor sections: what is linked to one skill on this device. Read by the app only, never a prompt (JM-D39). The material kinds are Study's AidKind and SourceKind together, widened when W9 added teaching_outline, video and video_link.

value.description: What is linked to one skill on this device (SPEC §21, JM-D38): the Study materials tagged to it (aids by their activity's tags or title, sources by title), the lecture moments whose transcript chunk names it (tagged at read time), the tutor's notes citing events on it, whether the tutor is tracking it, and its misconceptions. Device-only: the knows view's data, never sent to a model (JM-D39).

additions.why: Progress's hero: every installed subject as topic tiles. A live read records the open in the device's app_settings (JM-D45), never a learning event.
The skill sheet's Study materials, lecture moments, notes and tracked flag.
`?as_of=YYYY-MM-DD` replays the map to a date; a date over 26 weeks back, in the future or not a date is validation_failed.
